en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad and someone else, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ayoub Bin Nuh, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Ibn Muskan, from Badr Bin Al Waleed, from Abu Al Rabie Al Shamy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Imam<sup>asws</sup>, whenever he<sup>asws</sup> desires that he<sup>asws</sup> knows (something), knows (it)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Muhammad and others have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ayyub ibn Nuh from Safwan ibn Yahya from ibn Muskan from Badr ibn al-Walid from abu al-Rabi‘ al-Shami from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following. “
Would the Imam (a.s.) like to know he would know.”
